utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all. You alright? Quick one today, yeah? Before we start, whoever left a birthday cake in the office is now my favourite person.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Wasn't me, but I've had a slice already, for quality purposes.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Lucky you. I couldn't even get a brew, the broken coffee machine in the canteen's still dead.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That machine's got less uptime than some of our kit.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Steady on, Grace.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, stand-up. Safety first, then production, then maintenance bits. Any incidents overnight?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No incidents. I did notice the 11kV board was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so just an observation, not a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, and just on that, I tested the 11kV board yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done already.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Cheers. Production?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Line one held okay after the wobble. Also, just so nobody plans around it, the shutdown on the line 3 barrel is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine by me, I've got enough on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I noticed the compressor one was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just keeping an eye, not asking for anything today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted. Maintenance update, Tom?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Finished the repair on the Injection Moulding Line 1 last night, so that's off the board. It was the feed issue in the end.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, Tom.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: From CHP side, I've already swapped the filter on the GT1 Compressor Section yesterday, so don't duplicate that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good catch. Hannah, quality?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing dramatic. Only blocker is I can't get to the turbine one compressor until production gives us a window, so that's still stuck.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, not today, Hannah. We're flat out on that area.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, leave that parked then. Jamie, stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Bit of a pain, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the FLTs. I've chased again, but that's blocked waiting on them.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks. Let's go through today's actions then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First one, I'll replace the seals on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on the 3rd. It's not an emergency but don't let it slip, so I'll just keep that with me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, fair. It's weeping but it's not pouring out yet.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: As long as it's tracked, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round by the 28th. I didn't get that distribution cleaned up yesterday, so I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Please copy me this time, I got the last one second hand.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Forklifts as well — I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts first thing tomorrow, normal priority. Saz can pick that up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, that'll help days get moving.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: On safety, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the boiler safety valve today. It's urgent, so I'll get on that straight after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect, thanks Grace.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On the dryer sensors, was that still me or...?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, we need to recalibrate the sensors on the dryer next Tuesday, and that one's safety critical, straight away in terms of planning it in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't take that, to be honest. I'm tied up on CHP inspections and I haven't got the calibration kit free then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, no problem — I'll take it. Sarah Okafor will recalibrate the sensors on the dryer next Tuesday. That one's safety critical, straight away, so I'll own it and sort the kit.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Good, because the drift was outside where I'd like it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you schedule downtime for the line two with production by the end of the week? Needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll schedule downtime for the line two with production by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grab me after this and we'll line up a slot.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you book a contractor to look at the Compressed Air Dryer at half two? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I'll book a contractor to look at the Compressed Air Dryer at half two.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Half two today, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll get the call out sorted for at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice. Tom, can you check the guarding on the line 2 guard next week? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, Tom can do that. I'll check the guarding on the line 2 guard next week.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Can you just make sure it's the full guarding condition, not just a visual glance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah yeah, proper check, fixings and interlock alignment, the lot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Anything else that actually needs assigning today?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Not from me. The turbine one compressor thing is still blocked, so until production gives us a window there's nothing to assign there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, same on line 3 barrel, just to repeat, that's cancelled, so nobody go setting up isolation packs for that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Already crossed it off, mate.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got procurement bits, but no fresh actions for today beyond the line two downtime one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: CHP's steady. No new jobs from me.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just a reminder, if anyone's near that boiler safety valve area before me, leave the tags alone till I've done the sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Saz, on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit seals, do you want me to free up an operator on the 3rd or are you alright?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I should be alright, but if line one's hectic I'll shout. It's not an emergency but don't let it slip, that's the main thing.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I've got the seal kit in the cage still, by the way.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Even better.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And Sarah, on the handover report, by the 28th means today obviously, so if you ping it before lunch that'll save me chasing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, by the 28th, understood.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: For the dryer recalibration next Tuesday, do you need me there for verification?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Probably for sign-off, yeah. I'll set it up, but the action's mine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry I can't take that one, just no capacity.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, that's fine. Better to be clear now.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Jamie, once you've scheduled downtime for the line two with production by the end of the week, shove it in Teams, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Will do. Needs doing this week anyway, so I'll get it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And if you're carving out next week, give me a rough day for that line 2 guard check so I'm not pulled three ways.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll try and line it up sensibly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff. Quick recap then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've got replace the seals on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on the 3rd; send the shift handover report round by the 28th; do the pre-use checks on the forklifts first thing tomorrow, normal priority; and I'll take recalibrate the sensors on the dryer next Tuesday, that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've got do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the boiler safety valve today. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got schedule downtime for the line two with production by the end of the week. Needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I've got book a contractor to look at the Compressed Air Dryer at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And me, check the guarding on the line 2 guard next week. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect. No other new actions, and the blocked and cancelled bits stay blocked and cancelled. Anything urgent before we break?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Only urgent thing is someone fix that coffee machine.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's not going on my list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Put the birthday cake next to it, maybe it'll recover.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that highly technical note, thanks all.
